qualifying_updates.title: Retiring the Copilot Billing Preview app
qualifying_updates.date_qualification: Date-only August 4, 2026 is fully inside the collection window.
qualifying_updates.factual_summary: GitHub retired the Copilot Billing Preview app and points users to GitHub billing settings for AI usage, budgets, cost centers, usage pool allocation, exports, and the billing API.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: Teams using coding agents need cost controls and raw usage exports in the governed operating model, not a separate preview app. Wiki follow-up should emphasize budgets, user-level spend limits, cost-center allocation, and durable usage evidence for agent adoption reviews.
qualifying_updates.local_practice_implication: Record cost telemetry, budget caps, and exportable usage reports as required governance evidence for managed agent rollouts.

qualifying_updates.title: Upcoming deprecation of GitHub Spark on github.com
qualifying_updates.date_qualification: Date-only August 4, 2026 is fully inside the collection window.
qualifying_updates.factual_summary: GitHub Spark stopped accepting new users and new app creation on August 4, 2026. Existing users can access Spark until August 31, 2026 to export apps. Apps using the retired GitHub Models llm() function must move to another inference provider.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: AI-generated application workflows need export paths, provider replacement plans, and dependency checks for managed inference calls. Local wiki follow-up should treat this as an application-pattern and governance note, not as a broad product page.
qualifying_updates.local_practice_implication: For agent-built apps, keep generated source exportable and inventory managed inference calls so retirement or provider changes can be handled without losing maintainability.
